claim_ceiling: Internal paired FilmSet Capture One ClassNeg control evidence for a fixed spatial bank of bounded explicit colour operators; not film, stock, calibration, output-only reference recovery, product or preference evidence.
observations: The 16 bounded cell operators and shared control are structurally valid: minimum sampled Jacobian determinant 0.21356090815528012, maximum spectral norm 1.8929686510570076, maximum inverse error 4.016816468332962e-08 and exact replay.
On 16 held-out scenes the fixed spatial bank is 7.557204631884273% worse in mean RMSE than one shared global operator and wins only 2/16 rows.

The candidate is also 1.0301813561041318% worse in mean RMSE than the cyclic wrong-cell control. Fixed image coordinates therefore do not identify a transferable local colour mechanism on this paired software-recipe cohort.
CHAM2 remains valid only as synthetic patch-correspondence capacity. This result closes fixed coordinate-cell fitting on the consumed FilmSet cohort without changing the shared global fallback.
scientific_conclusion: A fixed 4x4 spatial bank adds capacity but not transferable information: it is safe and invertible yet generalizes materially worse than the simpler shared explicit operator. Close this exact coordinate-conditioned family without grid, regularization, threshold or same-cohort rescue. A successor requires an identifying observation such as independently matched regions or calibrated paired film/scanner data, not more spatial capacity.
